name: Glow year
what: A year or a number as the whole frame: rising in glowing over a liquid wave rolling at the bottom; or two huge lines that shrink in hard steps to a small mono line.

learned_from.what: the glowing 2026 over a green wave rolling at the bottom
a huge 20 / 26 shrinking into small blocky digits

motion: rises 20 f from a blur; the wave loops every 45 f; the stack shrinks in 6 steps over 18 f
